sentences.en: WOMAN: Good morning
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 早上好。

sentences.en: How can help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮您什么吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Hello
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好。

sentences.en: I'm interested in renting a house somewhere in the town
sentences.zh: 我想在镇上租一套房子。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Could I have your name please?
sentences.zh: 请问您贵姓？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, it's Steven Godfrey
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，我叫史蒂文·戈德弗雷。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And tell me how many bedrooms you're looking for
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 请告诉我您需要几间卧室。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, we'd need four, because I'm going to share the house with three Example friends
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我们需要四间，因为我将和三位朋友合租这套房子。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay, there are several of that size on our books
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，我们手头有几套符合这个规格的房子。

sentences.en: They mostly belong to families who are working abroad at the moment
sentences.zh: 它们大多属于目前在国外工作的家庭。

sentences.en: What about the location?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么地段方面呢？

sentences.en: MAN: It'd be nice to be central
sentences.zh: MAN: 最好能位于市中心。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That might be difficult, as most houses of that size are in the suburbs
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这可能有点困难，因为这类大小的房子大多位于郊区。

sentences.en: Still, there are a few
sentences.zh: 不过，市中心还是有几套的。

sentences.en: What's your upper limit for the rent?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您能接受的最高月租金是多少？

sentences.en: MAN: We'd like something around £500 a month, but a we could go up to £600 if we have to
sentences.zh: MAN: 我们希望每月租金在500英镑左右，但如果必要的话，最多可接受600英镑。

sentences.en: But we can't go beyond that
sentences.zh: 但我们无法超出这个上限。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Do you know how long you want to rent the house for?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您知道打算租住多长时间吗？

sentences.en: The minimum let is six months, as you probably realise
sentences.zh: 最低租期为六个月，这点您应该了解。

sentences.en: Test 3?
sentences.zh: 测试3？

sentences.en: MAN: We're at college here for two years, and we don't want to have to move during that time if we can avoid it
sentences.zh: MAN: 我们将在本地大学就读两年，如果可以避免的话，我们不希望在此期间搬离。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And how soon do you want to move in?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您希望何时入住？

sentences.en: All our lets start on the first of the month
sentences.zh: 我们所有的租赁合同均从每月1号开始。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, as soon as possible, really, so that means September 1st
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，越快越好，也就是说9月1号。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay, let me have a look at what we've got
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，让我看看我们有哪些房源……

sentences.en: We have photographs of all the houses on our books, so you can get an idea of what they're like
sentences.zh: 我们手头所有房屋都有照片，因此您可以先大致了解其情况。

sentences.en: There's this one in Oakington Avenue, at £550 a month
sentences.zh: 比如这套位于橡金顿大道的房子，月租550英镑。

sentences.en: Combined living room and dining room, with a separate kitchen
sentences.zh: 客厅与餐厅合并，另设独立厨房。

sentences.en: It doesn't have a garage, though you can park in the road
sentences.zh: 不过它没有车库，但您可以在路边停车。

sentences.en: MAN: Ah, we'd prefer to have one, if possible
sentences.zh: MAN: 啊，如果可能的话，我们更希望配有车库。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Then have a look at this house, in Mead Street
sentences.zh: 那么请看这套位于梅德街的房子。

sentences.en: It's a got a very large living room and kitchen, bathroom, cloakroom
sentences.zh: 它拥有非常宽敞的客厅和厨房、一间浴室、一间厕所……

sentences.en: MAN: How much is it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 租金多少？

sentences.en: WOMAN: That one's 580
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这套是580英镑。

sentences.en: It's very well furnished and equipped
sentences.zh: 它家具和设施都非常齐全。

sentences.en: It also has plenty of space for parking, and it's available for a minimum of a year
sentences.zh: 此外，停车位充足，且最短租期为一年。

sentences.en: Oh, and there's a big garden
sentences.zh: 哦，还有一个大花园。

sentences.en: MAN: don't think we could cope with that, to be honest
sentences.zh: 男士：说实话，我觉得我们应付不了。

sentences.en: We'll be too busy to look after it
sentences.zh: 我们会太忙，没时间打理它。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay
sentences.zh: 女士：好的。

sentences.en: Then there's this older house in Hamilton Road: living room, kitchen-diner, and a it has a study. 550 a month
sentences.zh: 然后是汉密尔顿路上这栋较老的房子：客厅、厨房兼餐厅，还有一间书房。每月550英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: That looks rather nice
sentences.zh: 男士：看起来相当不错。

sentences.en: But whereabouts in Hamilton Road?
sentences.zh: 但具体在汉密尔顿路的哪个位置？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Towards the western end
sentences.zh: 女士：靠近西端。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, that'll be very noisy
sentences.zh: 男士：哦，那会非常吵闹。

sentences.en: I know the area
sentences.zh: 我了解那个区域。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, it's pretty lively
sentences.zh: 女士：是的，那里相当热闹。

sentences.en: Some people like it, though
sentences.zh: 不过有些人就喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Well, what about this house in Devon Close?
sentences.zh: 那么，德文小巷的这栋房子呢？

sentences.en: MAN: That looks lovely
sentences.zh: 男士：看起来真漂亮。

sentences.en: WOMAN: There's a big a demand for houses in that area, so prices tend to be quite high
sentences.zh: 女士：那个区域的房子需求量很大，因此价格往往相当高。

sentences.en: But this one hasn't been decorated for a few years, which has kept a the rent down a bit
sentences.zh: 但这栋房子已有好几年未装修，所以租金略低一些。

sentences.en: It's got a living room, dining room and small kitchen, and it's 595 a month
sentences.zh: 它有客厅、餐厅和小厨房，每月595英镑。

sentences.en: I think it would suit you, from what you've said
sentences.zh: 根据您之前所说的情况，我觉得它应该很适合您。

sentences.en: MAN: It sounds fine
sentences.zh: 男士：听起来不错。

sentences.en: MAN: Why's that part of town so popular?
sentences.zh: 男士：为什么城区的那部分如此受欢迎？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, there's a big scheme to improve the district, and it'll soon have the best facilities for miles around
sentences.zh: 女士：嗯，当地正开展一项大规模的区域改善计划，建成后，它将拥有方圆数英里内最完善的设施。

sentences.en: MAN: What sort of thing?
sentences.zh: 男士：具体包括哪些方面？

sentences.en: WOMAN: There's a big sports centre under construction, which will be very impressive when it's finished
sentences.zh: 女士：一座大型体育中心正在建设中，完工后将非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: In fact the swimming pool's already opened, ahead of schedule, and it's attracting a lot of people
sentences.zh: 事实上，游泳池已提前开放，比原计划早了10个月，目前已吸引大量人群。

sentences.en: MAN:
sentences.zh: 男士：

sentences.en: What about cinemas: are there any in the area?
sentences.zh: 电影院呢？附近有电影院吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: The only one closed down last year, and it's now in the process of being converted into a film museum
sentences.zh: 女士：唯一的一家去年关闭了，目前正被改造成一座电影博物馆。

sentences.en: The local people are trying to a get a new cinema added to the scheme
sentences.zh: 当地居民正努力争取将新建一家电影院纳入该改善计划。

sentences.en: MAN: think I heard something about a plan to replace the existing concert hall with a larger one
sentences.zh: 男士：我想我听说过一项计划，打算用一座更大的音乐厅取代现有的音乐厅，也是提前10个月动工。

sentences.en: SLA
sentences.zh: SLA

sentences.en: WOMAN: Ah, that's due to start next year
sentences.zh: 女士：啊，那项工程预计明年启动。

sentences.en: MAN: Well it sounds an interesting area to live in
sentences.zh: 男士：嗯，听起来是个很有趣的居住区域。

sentences.en: Could go and please?
sentences.zh: 能去看一下吗？

sentences.en: see the house/Age.com
sentences.zh: 去看看那栋房子/Age.com

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: 女士：当然可以。
